# Contaminating $\boldsymbol{\Theta}_{j}$ {#sec-sensitivity}

Starting from the fitted sparse precisions (@eq-grn-export), apply the
misspecification factors described in DeCovarT
`vignettes/supp-S5-misspecification.qmd`:

1. Observation noise (Gaussian, $t_\nu$, PLN, contaminated Gaussian)
2. Missing reference component (0%, 2%, 10%)
3. Copula / PLN dependence across genes
4. Spillover between types
5. Outlier genes
6. Wrong covariance reference (perturb or subsample the glasso / PLN fit)

Zero-inflated or hurdle observation models belong **here**, as a
contamination of the sampling layer, not as the default GRN
(@nte-drop-zico).

Template: `scripts/05_01_sensitivity_precision_contamination.R`.

Compare `DeCovarT::deconvolute_ratios()` to mean-only baselines on the
**same** genes and mixtures. Pre-declare estimands and Monte Carlo error
as in the package synthetic-scenarios vignette `{#sec-nmeth}`.
